core_role: Primary tax-loss harvesting engine and diversification sleeve
fit_with_sndk_wdc: Best first-cut overlay because the loss engine is broad and not dependent on being right about memory stocks.
implementation_notes: Use separate-account lot control, avoid SNDK/WDC and close substitutes on the long side around sales, and maintain a restricted list for wash-sale review.

strategy_name: Tax-aware direct-index completion plus index/factor short
core_role: Broad equity replacement with tax-lot breadth and lower single-stock short complexity
fit_with_sndk_wdc: Good if the goal is to migrate into diversified equity while keeping the overlay simpler than a full market-neutral SMA.
implementation_notes: Short leg can use index/factor exposure, but ETF/fund shorts need tax and borrow review. Direct index long side creates more harvestable lots.

core_role: More direct sector-beta hedge with some tax-loss opportunity
fit_with_sndk_wdc: Useful for risk hedging, but less ideal as the main tax engine because it concentrates the overlay in the same risk cluster.
implementation_notes: Needs explicit restrictions on SNDK/WDC, memory peers, semiconductor ETFs, and any positions the tax adviser views as substantially identical or straddle-sensitive.

fit_with_sndk_wdc: Can hedge the thing you own, but it is the least clean tax-aware implementation because it is crowded, narrow, and tax-sensitive.
implementation_notes: Treat DRAM/storage shorts as a hedge sleeve, not the main harvesting engine. Borrow cost, recalls, short rebates, constructive-sale and straddle rules require review.

strategy_name: Collar, exchange fund, or staged sale plan
core_role: Risk-control or transition complement, not a long/short tax-loss engine
fit_with_sndk_wdc: Relevant as a parallel path if the client prioritizes drawdown control over harvesting losses.
implementation_notes: Options and prepaid/variable contracts need tax counsel review for constructive sale, straddle, qualified covered call, and holding-period effects.
